Mckinley Carter Wealth Services Inc increased its stake in Apple (AAPL) by 34% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mckinley Carter Wealth Services Inc bought 9,283 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 36,584 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.14M, up from 27,301 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mckinley Carter Wealth Services Inc who had been investing in Apple for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $908.91 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.29% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 15.09M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
